definition: AI systems that can plan, use tools, and act toward goals with limited human supervision.
details: Agentic AI wraps a language model in a loop of reasoning, tool use and feedback so it can carry out multi-step tasks instead of producing a single answer. It is the umbrella idea behind AI agents, autonomous agents and agentic workflows, and it is what lets systems operate software, browsers and APIs on a user's behalf.
story: Imagine handing a to-do list to a very clever intern who refuses to guess: before each step, they look around, check the result, and adjust. Think of it this way: AI systems that can plan, use tools, and act toward goals with limited human supervision. And here is the clever part: Agentic AI wraps a language model in a loop of reasoning, tool use and feedback so it can carry out multi-step tasks instead of producing a single answer. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Agentic AI.

citation.title: The Rise and Potential of Large Language Model Based Agents: A Survey
